author: Engineezy
description:
This machine can draw any shape
•••
Every mechanism I've built so far can only draw one shape. So I built one that can draw all of them using a custom app I coded with ChatGPT to create the cam profiles. Then I pushed it even further and turned it into an autograph machine.
